title: Why You MUST Work Out Every Day (5 Minute Beginner Workout)
hook: A 5 minute workout done every day gets beginners better results than a one hour workout done twice per week.
body: You'll barely feel any soreness after 5 minutes, so you won't be dreading your next workout. And there's no decision to make about whether you're working out today, it just becomes who you are, like brushing your teeth. The 5 minute workout is squats, push-ups, lunges and towel rows.

youtube_description:
A 5 minute workout done every day produces better results for beginners than a one hour workout done twice per week. In today's video I'm going to show you the 4 reasons why, plus the 5 minute workout to start with.

See what you'd look like with a six-pack, free:
https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=longform&utm_content=ro07-work-out-every-day

The 5 minute beginner workout (30 seconds each, no equipment):
1. Bodyweight squats
2. Push-ups (from your knees if you need to)
3. Lunges
4. Towel rows
5. Rest, jogging in place
Beginners: go through the circuit 2 times (5 minutes). More advanced: 3 or 4 times.

If you're a beginner, start with a 5 minute bodyweight workout at home every day, no equipment needed. The best time is the morning, the second best is immediately after work, and no matter what, don't work out late at night. Time your sets instead of counting reps. Then keep stepping it up another five minutes at a time until you're working out one hour per day over the next few years.

The plan:
Month 1: 5 minutes a day at home
Month 2: 10 minutes a day, with the basic equipment
Month 3: 15 minutes a day
Month 4: a home gym setup or a gym membership, then add 5 minutes at a time
